name: @deeptail/root
description: DeepTail: a Tauri desktop and mobile client that monitors and drives DeepSeek Harness sessions on a remote host.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --build tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/host-fleet/tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p apps/deeptail/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:browser: bun run --filter @deeptail/app build && bun test apps/deeptail/tests --timeout 60000
scripts.validate: bun run lint && bun run lint:ox && bun run check:styles && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run knip && bun run lint:rust && bun run test:rust && bun run test:browser
